OFFICE LEASE

This Office Lease (this "Lease") is dated 25 March 2021 and is made between Northbank Commercial REIT LP ("Landlord") and Fennimore & Lowe LLP ("Tenant").

1. Premises. Landlord leases to Tenant Suite 1210 of Bayside Corporate Park Building C (the "Premises"), containing 5,900 rentable square feet of rentable area.

2. Term. The term of this Lease is one hundred twenty (120) months (the "Term"), commencing on 1 August 2021 (the "Commencement Date") and expiring on 31 July 2031 (the "Expiration Date").

3. Extension Option. Tenant may renew this Lease for two (2) additional terms of sixty (60) months at a monthly Base Rent equal to the Base Rent in effect at expiration, by giving Landlord written notice at least one hundred eighty (180) days before the Expiration Date.

4. Base Rent. Tenant shall pay monthly Base Rent of $12,200.00 for the first Lease Year, in advance on the first day of each month.
4.2 On each anniversary of the Commencement Date, Base Rent increases by four percent (4%) over the Base Rent then in effect.

5. Operating Expenses. This is a net lease. Tenant shall pay Tenant's Share of Operating Expenses and Taxes, provided that Controllable Operating Expenses shall not increase by more than six percent (6%) per calendar year on a cumulative basis.

6. Security Deposit. Upon execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit $24,400.00 with Landlord as a security deposit.

7. Assignment and Subletting. Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet any part of the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which Landlord may grant or withhold in its sole discretion.

8. Holding Over. If Tenant remains in possession after the end of the Term, Tenant shall pay holdover rent equal to two hundred percent (200%) of the monthly Base Rent in effect at the end of the Term.

9. Miscellaneous. This Lease is governed by the laws of the state in which the Premises are located and binds the successors and permitted assigns of the parties.

Signed for Northbank Commercial REIT LP and for Fennimore & Lowe LLP by their authorized signatories.

OFFICE LEASE

This Office Lease (this "Lease") is dated September 15, 2020 and is made between Granite Peak Properties LP ("Landlord") and Wexford Advisory Partners LP ("Tenant").

ARTICLE 1 - PREMISES
Section 1.1 Landlord leases to Tenant Suite 900 of Kestrel Point II (the "Premises"), containing 10,600 rentable square feet (985 square meters) of rentable area.

ARTICLE 2 - TERM
Section 2.1 The term of this Lease is one hundred twenty (120) months (the "Term"), commencing on January 1, 2021 (the "Commencement Date") and expiring on December 31, 2030 (the "Expiration Date").

ARTICLE 3 - EXTENSION OPTION
Section 3.1 Tenant has one (1) option to extend the Term for five (5) years each at the Prevailing Market Rent, exercisable by written notice to Landlord given not less than six (6) months and not more than twelve (12) months before the expiration of the then-current Term.

ARTICLE 4 - BASE RENT
Section 4.1 Base Rent for the first Lease Year is $33.75 per rentable square foot per annum, payable in equal monthly installments in advance.
Section 4.2 On each anniversary of the Commencement Date, Base Rent increases by four percent (4%) over the Base Rent then in effect.

ARTICLE 5 - OPERATING EXPENSES
Section 5.1 This is a net lease. Tenant shall pay Tenant's Share of Operating Expenses and Taxes, provided that Controllable Operating Expenses shall not increase by more than five percent (5%) per calendar year on a cumulative basis.

ARTICLE 6 - SECURITY DEPOSIT
Section 6.1 Upon execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit $12,800.00 with Landlord as a security deposit.

ARTICLE 7 - ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING
Section 7.1 Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet any part of the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which Landlord may grant or withhold in its sole discretion.

ARTICLE 8 - HOLDING OVER
Section 8.1 If Tenant remains in possession after the end of the Term, Tenant shall pay holdover rent equal to two (2) times the monthly Base Rent in effect at the end of the Term.

ARTICLE 9 - MISCELLANEOUS
Section 9.1 This Lease is governed by the laws of the state in which the Premises are located and binds the successors and permitted assigns of the parties.

Signed for Granite Peak Properties LP and for Wexford Advisory Partners LP by their authorized signatories.

This Office Lease (this "Lease") is dated February 5, 2020 and is made between Northbank Commercial REIT LP ("Landlord") and Wexford Advisory Partners LP ("Tenant").

ARTICLE 1 - PREMISES
Section 1.1 Landlord leases to Tenant Suite 810 of 400 Elm Street (the "Premises"), containing 33,700 rentable square feet of rentable area.

Section 2.1 The term of this Lease is eighty-four (84) months (the "Term"), commencing on June 1, 2020 (the "Commencement Date") and expiring on May 31, 2027 (the "Expiration Date").

ARTICLE 3 - EXTENSION OPTION
Section 3.1 Tenant has two (2) options to extend the Term for five (5) years each at the Prevailing Market Rent, exercisable by written notice to Landlord given not less than nine (9) months and not more than twelve (12) months before the expiration of the then-current Term.

Section 4.1 Base Rent for the first Lease Year is $37.25 per rentable square foot per annum, payable in equal monthly installments in advance.
Section 4.2 On each anniversary of the Commencement Date, Base Rent increases by three percent (3%) over the Base Rent then in effect.

ARTICLE 5 - OPERATING EXPENSES
Section 5.1 Base Rent is a full service gross rent and includes Operating Expenses and Taxes; Tenant pays no separate share of Operating Expenses.

ARTICLE 6 - SECURITY DEPOSIT
Section 6.1 Upon execution of this Lease, Tenant shall deposit $33,300.00 with Landlord as a security deposit.

ARTICLE 7 - ASSIGNMENT AND SUBLETTING
Section 7.1 Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet any part of the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which Landlord shall not unreasonably withhold, condition or delay.

ARTICLE 8 - HOLDING OVER
Section 8.1 If Tenant remains in possession after the end of the Term, Tenant shall pay holdover rent equal to one and one-half (1.5) times the monthly Base Rent in effect at the end of the Term.

ARTICLE 9 - MISCELLANEOUS
Section 9.1 This Lease is governed by the laws of the state in which the Premises are located and binds the successors and permitted assigns of the parties.
